mentions.name: Open software change communication initiative
mentions.description: An open initiative to improve how software changes are communicated to people, systems, and AI, so that library and vendor updates are transparent instead of breaking things with hard-to-find changelogs.
mentions.problem: Library updates just deliver whatever is next, things break, finding a changelog is painful, and vendor updates may not clearly document changes.
mentions.audience: developers who deal with library and vendor updates
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a way for us to communicate software changes properly with people, systems and AI.

evidence.value: Working on a way for us to communicate software changes properly with people, systems and AI.
